_note: 學習路徑內容建置第12批 #3／6：that 名詞子句當受詞（eng.t_mid.nouncl.that-object，會考級／中階）。that 引導一個名詞子句，陳述一件事實或看法，當 think／know／believe／say／hope 等動詞的受詞：I think (that) he is right。that 常可省略；子句是『陳述句』（有自己的主詞＋動詞），不是問句。誘答以『後接完整陳述句用 that、what 需當子句內受詞、if/whether 問是否非陳述、語序錯』鎖唯一正解；P2 測 that 可省略。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix tho_）。

units.title_zh: that 名詞子句當受詞（I think (that)…）
units.can_do: 我能用 that 引導一個名詞子句來陳述事實或看法，當 think／know／believe／say／hope 等動詞的受詞（I think that he is right），知道 that 常可省略，而且 that 子句是有主詞＋動詞的陳述句。
units.situation_group: 名詞子句 The that-clause as object
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The conjunction 'that' introduces a noun clause that reports a fact or an opinion after verbs such as think, know, believe, say and hope: 'I believe that he is telling the truth.'
claims.verification_ref: that 引導名詞子句、陳述事實/看法，接 think/know/believe/say/hope；I believe that he is telling the truth；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The 'that'-clause works as the object of the verb — it is the thing you think, know or say: in 'I hope that you feel better', the clause is the object of 'hope'.
claims.verification_ref: that 子句當動詞的受詞；I hope that you feel better 中子句是 hope 的受詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In everyday English the 'that' is often optional and can be left out, with no change in meaning: 'I think (that) he is right.'
claims.verification_ref: 口語 that 常可省略、意思不變；I think (that) he is right；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The clause after 'that' is a statement with its own subject and verb (he is right), not a question; to report a yes/no question we use 'whether/if', not 'that'.
claims.verification_ref: that 子句是陳述句（有主詞+動詞），非問句；是非問句用 whether/if；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: We often use 'that' to introduce a clause that states a fact or an opinion. It comes after verbs like think, know, believe, say, and hope, and works as their object: I think that he is right. The part after 'that' - 'he is right' - is the thing you think.
teach.zh_hint: 我們常用 that 帶出一個子句，來「陳述一件事實或看法」，放在 think／know／believe／say／hope 這些動詞後面當受詞：I think that he is right.（我認為他是對的。）that 後面的 he is right 就是你所想的那件事。

teach.body: I think that he is right.
teach.zh_hint: 我認為他是對的。that 子句是 think 的受詞。

teach.body: In speaking, this 'that' can often be left out, and the meaning stays exactly the same: 'I think he is right.' is the same as 'I think that he is right.'
teach.zh_hint: 在口語裡，這個 that 常常可以「省略」，意思完全不變：I think he is right. 和 I think that he is right. 一樣。

teach.body: She knows that you are busy.
teach.zh_hint: 她知道你很忙。也可以省略成 She knows you are busy。

teach.body: After 'that' comes a statement - it has its own subject and verb (he is right / you are busy), not a question. If you want to say a yes/no question like 'whether or not ...', use 'whether' or 'if', not 'that'.
teach.zh_hint: that 後面是一個「陳述句」——有自己的主詞和動詞（he is right／you are busy），不是問句。如果要說「是不是……」這種是非問句，就用 whether／if，不用 that。

teach.body: We hope that it will not rain.
teach.zh_hint: 我們希望不會下雨。that 帶出一個陳述句。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：I believe ____ he is telling the truth.（我相信他說的是實話）

distractor_rationales.what: 後面是完整陳述句 he is telling the truth（不缺受詞）；what 要當子句內的受詞用，這裡用 that。
distractor_rationales.which: which 引導形容詞子句、需先行詞；這裡帶出陳述句當受詞，用 that。
distractor_rationales.who: who 指人當主詞；這裡要帶出一整句陳述，用 that。

practice.feedback: 後接完整陳述句、表所相信的事用 that：I believe that he is telling the truth。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句正確（that 可以省略）？
options: I think what he is right.
I think if he is right.
I think which he is right.

what 會使句子不通（he is right 不缺受詞）；直接省略成 I think he is right。
if 表『是否』、是問是非，意思變成不確定；陳述看法用 that 或直接省略。
which 用錯；陳述看法直接 I think he is right。

practice.feedback: that 可省略：I think (that) he is right 兩種都對。

practice.stem: 在 'I hope that you feel better' 中，that 子句在句中當？

distractor_rationales.主詞: 主詞是 I；that 子句在動詞 hope 後面，是『所希望的事』＝受詞。
distractor_rationales.形容詞: that 子句不是修飾名詞的形容詞，而是整個當名詞用的受詞。
distractor_rationales.副詞: 它不是修飾動詞的副詞，而是 hope 的受詞。

practice.feedback: that 子句是動詞 hope 的受詞（你所希望的那件事）。

practice.answer: I think that this movie is great.
options: I think that this movie is great.
I think that this movie great.
I think that is this movie great.
I think this movie that is great.

that 後面要有完整句子，缺動詞 is。
that 後面是陳述句、不是問句語序（is this…?）。
that 位置錯，應放在子句最前面：that this movie is great。

practice.feedback: that ＋ 完整陳述句：I think that this movie is great。

practice.stem: 'I think that it will rain' 還可以正確地說成？
options: I think what it will rain.
I think it will rain that.

這是問句語序；that 子句要陳述句語序 it will rain。
what 用錯，使句子不通；直接省略 that 即可。
that 要放在子句前面當引導詞，不放句尾。

practice.feedback: that 可省略：I think it will rain ＝ I think that it will rain。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: I think that she will win the game.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：that 有沒有寫對、she will win 有沒有寫對、the game 有沒有漏、句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。主句輕起、that 子句連貫一起唸、句尾下收。
